chapter: Tulane, Tuxedo and Waifs' Home bands
title: Players in the original Tuxedo band under Celestin
summary: He sat in during Papa Celestin's time and lists John Porter, Louis Dumaine, Celestin, Peter Bocage and Sonny Henry.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay, let's see, this is reel two of Wilbert Tillman, January 20th, 1966. We were talking about the Tulane Van, and you say you can't remember too many more other than those we just named, huh? No, I can't remember them. That's too far back. Oh, yeah. Well, did you ever play with the original Toxia? The original Toxia? Yeah, when...
I never was a member, but I had played with them during Papa Celestan time. Yeah, I played with them, but I never was a member of them.
I see. Do you remember who was in that band, any of the people on that you heard?
Yeah, John Porter, Lewis Tillman, Celestan, and...
Excuse me, we better check and see what instruments they played, because some of them played two or three, you know? John Porter played...
Well, John Porter played bass and baritone. All right. In the same band, different times?

You see, sometimes they'd use him on baritone, sometimes they'd use him on bass. I see. And Louis DeMere was a trumpet player, and Celestan was a trumpet player. And they used to use lavender occasion, used to use Peter Bocard. I think Peter Bocard was once a member. Mm-hmm. He was a regular member of the band. And they had Sonny Henry on trombone. I can't play swells with Pam Trombone on the side.
